question: Under the frozen B02 Eevee review pipeline, does reducing renderSamples from 32 to 1 restore exact decoded-pixel reproducibility, and is that result conditional on output dither intensity?

design.type: 2x2 full factorial with two clean sequence replicates per cell

decisionRule.SAMPLING_CAUSAL_SUPPORT: Both sample-1 cells pass exact decoded pixels, both fresh sample-32 cells remain non-exact, and all controls and attacks pass.
decisionRule.SAMPLING_NOT_SUFFICIENT: Both sample-1 cells contain at least one decoded-pixel difference, both fresh sample-32 cells remain non-exact, and the experiment is valid.
decisionRule.MIXED_OR_BASELINE_UNSTABLE: Exactly one sample-1 cell is exact, or either fresh sample-32 cell is exact, with an otherwise valid experiment.
decisionRule.INVALID_EXPERIMENT: Any frozen identity, run invariant, intervention control, sequence binding, comparison binding or negative-attack gate fails.

secondaryObservations: PNG container equality is measured separately and never substitutes for decoded-pixel equality.
Differing-frame counts, failed-pixel counts and maximum error are descriptive only; no post-hoc tolerance or significance test is permitted.
Fresh sample-32 cells test whether the historical B15/B16 non-exact pattern replicates in the same experimental batch.
Cross-cell image equality is not expected because sample count and dither intentionally change pixels; the causal response is within-cell A/B reproducibility.
requiredNegativeCases: requested dither outside the frozen factor levels
observed renderSamples differs from the cell
comparison artifact not bound to both sequence hashes
explicitNonClaims: An exact sample-1 result would not prove that Eevee is generally deterministic or identify a specific internal race without source-level evidence.
Sample-1 output is not asserted to be visually acceptable and may have materially worse antialiasing, lighting or effects quality.
The experiment does not select a perceptual tolerance and does not convert near-equality into equality.
The result applies to this same-machine Blender 5.2 Eevee PNG8 review profile, not Cycles EXR masters or other devices.
Two runs per cell can falsify exact determinism but cannot estimate a general probability of mismatch.
A small difference in failed-pixel counts across cells is not by itself a causal effect estimate.
